      "observations": [
        "Retained complete12-path source study reused. Fresh sections reconcile all36 actual submitted review rows, including old WIP cohorts and summary history, against the password form/template, email controller, tests and CSS/SVG outcome.",
        "The live rememberSignons getter is placed in the constructor and initial connected state explicitly applies its value. Original landing uses toggleAttribute(checked,allowed); fixed source uses defaultChecked and checked properties plus disabled. Do not teach the historical attribute toggle as the current checkbox state contract.",
        "The requested signon.rememberSignons test is added. Historical first true-state assertion messages say disabled/unchecked despite testing enabled/checked; fixed messages now match expressions and explicitly push true and false preference environments. A should word alone does not make an assertion message correct. Direct assertions were read, not executed.",
        "The password input uses native required/checkValidity and a real label. Empty placeholder is defended for animation and retained; current CSS uses :placeholder-shown with the adjacent animated label. Event discussion mentions bubbles versus composed, but actual landing dispatches bubbles:true without composed; the discussion is not proof of a new shadow-boundary requirement.",
        "The early-exit request yields a negative password-target guard with break in the original switch, not the literal return proposed in the inline sample. Fixed input handling later changes. Reviewer compiler-efficiency wording is attributed opinion, not a measured result or universal rule.",
        "After requested changes for the wrong static Back destination, original entry from outgoing/manual or discovered-config state stores the originating state as password previousStep. Review agrees edits persist while moving within manual incoming/outgoing, but leaving to autoconfig discards manual edits for discovered configuration. A discard warning and view/data refactor are explicitly later ideas; source comparison does not claim those warnings exist.",
        "Errors gain readable messages with localization metadata on Error.cause, and #currentSubview becomes a getter. Current #validateAndFinish awaits verification but calls async #finishEmailAccountAddition without awaiting; its completion must not be described as backend creation completion. Fixed password test separately waits for the backend account.",
        "Disabled-checkbox appearance and path-level SVG context fill/opacity are applied. Template indentation and blank line after test imports are local review nits, not evidence of a repository-wide fixed grouping count. OAuth skipping/prepopulation, close-button focus and later sync improvements are explicitly deferred; original sync custom-element registration alone did not implement resource selection.",
        "Complete Bug1919663 comments0–2 and D227549 full timeline/all36 actual submitted rows plus summary detail read. Linked parent/child reviews, Try/linter tasks and later follow-up remain unopened related context. Design/working-password reports are historical, not local validation."
      ],

        "Account Hub password state uses checkbox properties and the remember-signons policy",
        "Password validity, labels and submission are native form contracts in Account Hub",
        "Account creation errors carry a readable message and structured localization cause",

        "Account Hub sync step grew from a placeholder into selected resource state",
        "Account Hub password tests correlate events with entered values and verify backend results separately",
        "Account Hub password names separate custom tags, template IDs and localized UI identifiers"
